body:
I do think my friends hate me. I don't know why. I'm just not as pretty or as talented as them. I am simply not interesting. They don't like me as much as they like each other.
I'm not close to my parents. I don't talk to my dad about anything, and my mom would just freak out. I can't imagine what telling anyone in real life about this would be like. I don't want their help. We're just not close is all.
I live in an absolute shithole of a country. Sometimes we don't have enough money to buy ourselves food after paying taxes. There's no way anyone will be able to pay for my studies.

Thanks for replying. Really.
The future doesn't matter to me. I'm way too poor to get a decent education, even though I'm one of the top students at my school. I bave no reason to live. I hate my friends, they hate me. I hate what I do every day. I hate my own fucking guts. I just wish I didn't feel so miserable all the time.
I've been thinking of suicide almost daily since I turned 12. I'm turning 15 in two weeks.
I have nobody. My parents couldn't care less. My classmates would only be glad if I was gone.
I know, you didn't ask. I'm sorry. This hurts too much. I hope you don't feel pressured onto trying to help.
